transactions.headerBody: Manage your active book loans, initiate new issues, and record returns — all in one place. Every transaction is logged automatically and your due dates are tracked in real time.
transactions.issueBody: Enter the book's ISBN or title and your member ID to initiate a checkout. The standard loan period is 14 days from the issue date.
transactions.activeBody: All books currently checked out under your account are listed below. Loans highlighted in amber are due within 3 days; those in red are overdue.
transactions.historyBody: A complete log of all past returns associated with your account. Transactions that incurred overdue fines are linked to your Fine Management page.

fines.headerBody: View and track your overdue fines, payment status, and fine calculation details. All fines are calculated at Rs. 5 per day after the 14-day standard loan period.
fines.policyBody: Overdue fines are calculated at Rs. 5 per day for each book returned after the 14-day standard loan period. Fines must be cleared at the library counter before new books can be issued. For fine waivers or disputes, contact the librarian at helpdesk@ncbae.edu.pk or visit the circulation desk.
